scope: User-confirmed sidebar DOM reproduced with synthetic names, plus simulated frame results; not live hospital access
checks: Reads the confirmed leftContents/vertical/font DOM with DIV-image logout without clicking it
Line breaks and fullwidth whitespace in the sidebar are normalized
Unrelated sidebar text, hidden fields and identically named patient-area elements are ignored
Conflicting names in the exact login field fail closed
An empty login field does not infer a name from nearby text
Name extraction is independent of logout labels and screen coordinates
A login page does not supply a pharmacist
The same verified field supports text nodes without a FONT wrapper
Without the confirmed field, nearby name-like text is never guessed
A sibling frame can supply the name; conflicting frames are rejected
